title: Orsyn rule
description: One export or scheme rule. Every rule carries a source, a checked date and a review date. Rule files in packages/rules contain rules of this shape; models explain rules but never create them.

id.description: Stable slug, lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens, for example eu-cbam. Never reused for a different rule.

layer.description: 1 = applies to every exporter, 2 = depends on product code and market, 3 = benefits and schemes.

applies_to.description: What the rule applies to, for example goods.

market.description: Destination market the rule applies to, for example EU. Use the market code the roadmap uses for the rule.

hs_prefixes.description: HS code prefixes the rule applies to, as digit strings of 2 to 8 digits. Empty means the rule does not depend on product code (layer 1 and some layer 3 rules).

title.description: Short plain-words heading shown to the supplier.

body.description: Plain-English explanation a foundry owner understands. Guideline is 40 words or fewer; hard limit 320 characters. Tax steps say to confirm with your CA.

mandatory.description: True if the step is required by law or the scheme for the exporter; false if optional or advisory.

status_logic.description: Name of the code path that decides the roadmap status of this rule. New values need a backend change; the curator only describes them.

source.description: Where the rule comes from. For review_state verified this must be a primary source that was opened.

name.description: Issuing body or publication, for example DGFT, CBIC, GST portal, EU Official Journal.

url.description: Link to the source document that was opened.

reference.description: Notification, circular, regulation or section number inside the source.

checked_on.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the source was last opened and checked.

review_by.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) by which the rule must be checked again, before any dated fact in it can go stale.

review_state.description: verified = a primary source was opened and its reference recorded. awaiting_review = created from a secondary source or not yet checked against a primary one.
